Go if you like paying double for a meal
Nov 2024 • Family
If you like paying twice for your meal, this is the place to go. They claim processing issues with card payment, insist you pay cash and promise to refund the card charge if it does not reverse within a day. Well, the card charge does not reverse, and they ignore all contact attempts. They don't answer (multiple) emails, they don't answer the phone, they don't respond to Facebook messages or posts. When we finally got hold of someone on WhatsApp, they promised to resolve, then they basically said "too bad, we don't see the charge on our account" and stop responding. Totally fraudulent.

reviews.review_text:
HabaneraW12
Vinuela, Spain19 contributions
0
Strange and arrogant service, bland expensive food.
Dec 2024 • Family
Very disappointing. Food mediocre at best, service with a nasty undertone. Clearly don’t enjoy tourists as clients. Ribs were very fatty. Crispy noodles were soggy with a bland sauce. Fish ok. Fried rice was very plain. Spring rolls ok. 

My 10 year old son accidentally broke a glass (slipped out of his hand with the condensation), they were more interested in telling me I had to pay 80,000 dong for a replacement glass than checking my son was alright or cleaning up. My kids aren’t clumsy, and are super polite not noisy. In all my over 70 counties I’ve visited, I have never heard of anyone charging for a broken glass (three times the replacement price), as it’s included in natural wear and tear. And let’s just say for the food and quantity it was already an expensive restaurant. 

Kids were playing chess and the staff strangely took over the game as they were clearly bored. 

The roof terrace was pretty, with nice lanterns.

Written December 18, 2024
